svg.text: PHYSICAL-NOUN GATES · THE MACHINES MUST DIFFER BEFORE LABELS
No screens, meters, glow, baked UI, amber/rose product accents, camera cues, wear, or SKU clutter.
Two equal feeds meet a horizontal balance bridge and
paired calipers. The output is a comparison result.
Two audit towers descend into a vertical certification
jaw and physical seal. The output is certified—or
Duplicator owns the repeated-page gesture; Binding Press owns the compressed stack and physical
